answer_4.quote: we perform human evaluation of the generated comments... Each annotated datapoint consists of an instruction and two randomly sampled generations... we ask the annotator which generations they prefer.
answer_4.guideline: Please ask yourself if Candidate A or B is better. Here, 'better' means that the respective Candidate most closely reflects the reference comments and aligns with your knowledge of that party's stance on the respective policy question.
